concerns.text: FR-004 requires mapping stack traces to vulnerability categories, but the 'simplified CVSS-like rubric' for assigning severity_scores (used by FR-005, SC-002, SC-003) is never defined — not even its dimensions or scale. Without a specified rubric, severity scores are not reproducible and the KS test on severity (SC-002) cannot be verified as consistently computed. Specify the rubric (e.g., category × exploitability/impact ordinal scale) or reference where it will be documented.

FR-003 says 'for a fixed duration, enforced by a hard timeout' without naming the value; the Edge Cases section fixes 30 minutes. State the duration in FR-003 (or cross-reference the edge case) so the criterion is checkable without hunting.
